entries.title: Observe the Instrument
entries.description: Spend a working session watching how your main tool shapes what you make, without trying to change anything.

entries.title: Question the Default
entries.description: Take one default setting, template, or first suggestion and find out who chose it and what it costs you.

entries.title: Build Badly
entries.description: Make the worst working version on purpose, quickly, to find out what the problem actually is.

entries.title: Work With AI
entries.description: Direct the instrument through a whole small task, staying the author of every decision it hands back to you.

entries.title: Work Without AI
entries.description: Do the same kind of task with no assistance, and notice which muscles are sore afterwards.

entries.title: Compare the Two
entries.description: Put the assisted and unassisted work side by side and write down exactly where they differ.

entries.title: Separate Signal From Noise
entries.description: Take a stream of information you follow and sort a week of it into signal, unfamiliar units, and actual noise.

entries.title: Analyse a Generated Artifact
entries.description: Take one AI output and take it apart: the claim, the load-bearing parts, the unexamined assumptions.

entries.title: Reconstruct a Creative Process
entries.description: Take a finished work you admire and write the sequence of decisions that plausibly produced it.
